system.description: Relentless Force: You gain a bonus to your damage thresholds and your damage rolls equal to double your Momentum (instead of just your Momentum).

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Momentum's effect adds the bonus once; add the second time by hand. An effect on this feature can't read the Momentum value, which lives on another item.
